name: Boxed
source:
It’s late, but you can’t sleep just yet… anxiety has been creeping up your spine your entire ride home, and you’re stressed beyond belief. You can’t wait to call your partner but~ you don’t want them to see you like this… you need to relax.

[From [url=https://mixtress.itch.io/boxed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
已经很晚了，但你还无法入睡……在回家的路上，焦虑一直在你的脊椎上蔓延，你承受着难以置信的压力。你迫不及待地想给你的伴侣打电话，但是~你不想让他们看到你这样……你需要放松。

[来自[url=https://mixtress.itch.io/boxed]itch.io[/url]]
